verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a RESTful API with JWT authentication, regional endpoints, and an MCP/CLI offering, but nowhere mentions an official SDK or client library for any language. Third-party API providers such as fal.ai and Vercel AI Gateway are not official Kling SDKs. A raw REST API and a CLI are adjacent capabilities, not the SDK this story asks about.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
